The tracked bet that pursuing an opportunity will advance a goal. An Initiative stays open, trying one Solution after another if needed, until its outcome is reached or the bet is disproven.

- **Definition:** [Glossary: Initiative](/system/glossary)
- **How it works:** [Initiatives and solutions](/system/initiatives-and-solutions)
- **Owner:** product manager
- **Links to:** Children: [Solution](/templates/solution)

## Template

| Field | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| Initiative | Short descriptive name |
| Goal | The goal it advances |
| Hypothesis | We believe [problem space] represents an opportunity to advance [goal] by [approach hypothesis]. |
| Outcome measure | The change that tells us it worked, tied to the goal, with a starting value |
| Evidence | 2-3 bullets showing the problem exists and matters. Link research, data and tickets. |
| Audience | Who has the problem, how many people and how often |
| Solutions | Each Solution tried, with its status (exploring, testing, building, live, on hold, dropped) and what we learned |
| Government considerations | Accessibility, privacy and security, legal or policy, labor, public communication, budget or procurement timing |
| Status | Active, outcome reached, or stopped, with the date and what we learned |

## DMV example

**Initiative: Single-trip new driver licenses** (framed at Q2 planning, active from Q2)

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Initiative | Single-trip new driver licenses |
| Goal | Zero multi-trip experiences for standard licenses (Goal 2) |
| Hypothesis | We believe repeat trips for standard new driver license applications represent an opportunity to advance Goal 2 (zero multi-trip experiences) by helping applicants know they are ready before they come in. |
| Outcome measure | Share of standard new license applications needing more than one trip. Starting value 85%. |
| Evidence | Counter staff log "missing or wrong document" as the top turn-away reason. The idea log holds three related ideas, including a counter clerk's "show a document checklist before someone comes in." |
| Audience | First-time applicants, many of them teens and new Oregon residents, plus the parents who come with them. Counter staff. |
| Solutions | **A. Document checklist** (S): prototyped in Q2, dropped. In a click-through test, 3 of 5 applicants still picked the wrong birth certificate type. **B. License Ready Check** (XL): survived testing, building from Q3. **C. Real-time eligibility check at the counter** (XL): on hold until shared identity verification can check license eligibility, not just identity. |
| Government considerations | WCAG 2.1 AA and language access. Retention rules for uploaded documents. Labor consultation on changes to counter work. |
| Status | Active |
